newsitem.title: USA: V-ONE says has encryption export approval.
newsitem.headline: V-ONE says has encryption export approval.

text.p: V-ONE Corp said it received permission from the U.S. Commerce Department to export powerful computer encryption software.

But to get permission, the Rockville, Maryland-based software firm had to include a feature known as key recovery that allows the government to decode any message encrypted with the company's products, V-ONE told Reuters.
Encryption products, increasingly important for online commerce and global communications on the Internet, scramble information and render it unreadable without a password or software "key."

V-ONE said its software, used to secure Internet communications, permitted the government to recover encryption keys without forcing customers to keep duplicates of their keys with a third party, as some other products require.
With a case-by-case approval from the Commerce Department, a customer could act as its own key recovery agent, the company said.

The export approval came under a new Clinton administration policy that took effect at the beginning of the year. Companies can export stronger encryption than previously allowed but only if they incorporate key recovery features.
Companies that promise to add key recovery within two years can export medium-strength encryption under the Clinton policy.
Privacy advocates and some software companies strongly oppose the policy, which they say hurts software sales abroad and could allow improper government intrusions.
V-ONE said it was the only company able to export a key recovery product that did not require third party involvement, but other companies questioned the claim.

Trusted Information Systems has permission to export several encryption products and although the company designated a government-approved third-party, a customer could get permission to act as its own key recovery agent, spokesman Cabe Franklin said.
An official at International Business Machines Corp said the company's encryption technology could be used in a similar manner.
